definitions.short: Abiezer , the name of two Israelites
definitions.full: H44. Abiezer אֲבִיעֶ֫זֶר proper name, masculine ( my father is help ) — = אִיעֶזֶר Num 26:30 — 1 a Manassite , called 'son' of Gilead Num 26:30 (compare Di) Josh 17:2 ; Judg 6:34 ; 8:2 ; and son of Gilead's sister 1Chr 7:18 . 2 a Benjamite , a warrior of David 2Sam 23:27 ; 1Chr 11:28 ; 27:12 .
definitions.rootNote: from 1 and 5829 ; father of help (i.e. helpful);
